paper_title: The Evolution of Darija Open Dataset Introducing Version 2
caption: Distribution of Content Types in the DODa

annotations.annotation: The pie chart represents different categories of data collection, shown in a doughnut format, with a total of six slices. The categories are labeled as follows: "Moroccan Names" in orange, "Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy)" in purple, "Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives)" in orange, "Translated Sentences" in yellow, "Extra + Augmented Data" in blue, and "Pending Translations" in green. The chart features a legend on the right for identifying the slices by color. Inside the slices, numerical labels are present to denote quantity: "Moroccan Names" shows 23,108, "Translated Sentences" shows 45,387, "Extra + Augmented Data" indicates 30,000, and "Pending Translations" shows 43,000. Smaller slices representing "Semantic Categories" and "Syntactic Roles" do not appear to have numerical labels visible. The slices are displayed in no particular order based on their size, and no particular visual emphasis on any slice of the pie is there.
